0336__L8_TAY_30__3D94BFC5.mp3.asr_text: You heard the gaffer. Let's go, Sharp.
0336__L8_TAY_30__3D94BFC5.mp3.translation: 听见头儿的话了，走吧，夏普。
0336__L8_TAY_30__3D94BFC5.mp3.note: Sharp统一为已有中文人名夏普，其余同名喊话同样处理。

0337__L8_COO_178__C5BCB5FD.mp3.asr_text: Infantry coming from the front, sir!

0338__L8_MAD_61__0F469AFF.mp3.asr_text: What did I tell you? Now they know we're here. Everyone pull out. Now!
0338__L8_MAD_61__0F469AFF.mp3.translation: 我怎么说的？这下他们知道我们来了。所有人撤出去，马上！

0340__L8_MAD_86__12F6C1C2.mp3.asr_text: Good question. Wait here, I'm gonna find out.
0340__L8_MAD_86__12F6C1C2.mp3.translation: 问得好，在这儿等着，我去看看。

0341__L8_MAD_17__0712ECEA.mp3.asr_text: Hurry it up, Sharp! We don't have all night!
0341__L8_MAD_17__0712ECEA.mp3.translation: 夏普，快点！没工夫陪你耗一晚上！

0342__L8_MAD_20__08652102.mp3.asr_text: Sharp, take that sniper's rifle and deal with that patrol!
0342__L8_MAD_20__08652102.mp3.translation: 夏普，捡那把狙击步枪，收拾那队巡逻兵！

0344__L8_TAY_99__4850A708.mp3.asr_text: There's a sniper in that window to the northwest.
0344__L8_TAY_99__4850A708.mp3.translation: 西北边的那个窗口有个狙击手。

0345__L8_TAY_100__0B3212C5.mp3.asr_text: These buggers usually work in pairs, but I can't see another one.
0345__L8_TAY_100__0B3212C5.mp3.translation: 这些混蛋通常两人一组，可我没看见另一个。

0347__L8_TAY_102__0B4E41C7.mp3.asr_text: You take him out and I'll signal Sarge.
0347__L8_TAY_102__0B4E41C7.mp3.translation: 你干掉他，我给中士打信号。

0349__L8_MAD_175__DB8C7647.mp3.asr_text: Okay, Taylor's gonna set the explosives.

0351__L8_MAD_1__A560AD29.mp3.asr_text: Jerry's been using Bastogntown Square as a supply point for their armor units here. That armor's the reason why the Yanks are having such a hard time breaking through.
0351__L8_MAD_1__A560AD29.mp3.translation: 德国佬把巴斯托涅镇广场当成了这片装甲部队的补给点。就是那些坦克，害得美国人一直打不过来。

0352__L8_MAD_149__D6A64A6E.mp3.asr_text: Looks like that's the last of them.

0353__L8_TAY_151__13C86561.mp3.asr_text: Yeah, and tell them that we did the hard part for them.
0353__L8_TAY_151__13C86561.mp3.translation: 对，别忘了告诉他们，难活儿都让咱们干了。

0355__L8_GER_26__4E633784.mp3.note: ASR仅为Thank you，与AM的无线电问句完全不同；按用户要求保留ASR意思，需重点听音，未以旧稿替换。

0356__L8_GER_23__4E38F101.mp3.asr_text: I told you I would kill for the strudel. My rations don't even have chocolate, just bread.
0356__L8_GER_23__4E38F101.mp3.translation: 早说了，为了那口酥卷我都肯杀人。我的口粮连巧克力都没有，只有面包。
0356__L8_GER_23__4E38F101.mp3.note: 德军角色的ASR输出为英语，按识别语义翻译，未推断实际发声语言。

0358__L8_MAD_140__D62776E5.mp3.asr_text: Private Davies, seal that door. We don't want anyone following us.
0358__L8_MAD_140__D62776E5.mp3.translation: 戴维斯，把门封住，我可不想有人跟上来。

0359__L8_DAV_42__C32B2ED9.mp3.asr_text: Sir, the infantry from that convoy, they're heading for us!
0359__L8_DAV_42__C32B2ED9.mp3.translation: 长官，车队里的步兵朝我们来了！

0360__L8_MAD_56__0DD837E5.mp3.asr_text: Tailor's signaling something. Ah, hell, there's something wrong with the detonators. Sharp, look lively. You'll have to hit them with the sniper rounds to set them off.
0360__L8_MAD_56__0DD837E5.mp3.translation: 泰勒在打信号。我操，雷管出了毛病。夏普，快，用狙击枪把炸药打爆！

0361__L8_MAD_64__0F70E182.mp3.asr_text: Excellent work for once, Taylor. Use them to take out the other tanks. Sharp, you too. Don't worry about the ones under repair. Fire only at active Jerry Panzers.
0361__L8_MAD_64__0F70E182.mp3.translation: 泰勒，你总算干了件漂亮事。拿那些家伙去打其它坦克，夏普也去。别管还在修的，只打能动的德军坦克。

0362__L8_DAV_132__05545291.mp3.asr_text: More approaching from the outside as well, sir! Southeast!
0362__L8_DAV_132__05545291.mp3.translation: 长官，外面还有敌人过来！东南方向！

0363__L8_COO_72__18961F8C.mp3.asr_text: Sir! Anti-Armor infantry spotted down the alley to the southeast!
0363__L8_COO_72__18961F8C.mp3.translation: 长官！东南边的小巷里发现反坦克步兵！

0364__L8_MAD_29__08E3F48B.mp3.translation: 根据已知情报，我猜敌人早就防着有人会从这潜入，前头可能还有更多敌人在等着我们。泰勒，带上夏普去侦察，注意搜寻狙击手和炮兵观察哨。
0364__L8_MAD_29__08E3F48B.mp3.note: ASR因超长跳过。未使用AM旧稿补写，待补识别或听音。

0366__L8_MAD_92__14733C5D.mp3.asr_text: Stay alert lads, this isn't over yet!
0366__L8_MAD_92__14733C5D.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，别松懈，还没完呢！

0367__L8_MAD_10__06B04863.mp3.asr_text: Dammit, now they know we're here! Push up to the windmill and engage them!
0367__L8_MAD_10__06B04863.mp3.translation: 我干，他们知道我们来了！推进到风车那边，打掉他们！

0369__L8_MAD_173__DB704745.mp3.asr_text: I want you to hold your fire until I give the order. Everything needs to go smoothly or we could end up with half the German army on our heads.
0369__L8_MAD_173__DB704745.mp3.translation: 我没下令之前，谁也不许开枪。这事必须办得干净利落，不然半个德国陆军都得扑过来。

0370__L8_TAY_2__0A30AA06.mp3.asr_text: Typical Jerry. Always well prepared. He's probably got enough ammo and fuel stacked up to keep him in business here for months, hasn't he?
0370__L8_TAY_2__0A30AA06.mp3.translation: 德国佬就这样，什么都准备妥当。弹药燃料怕是够他们在这儿耗上几个月吧？

0371__L8_DAV_163__0A80F3EF.mp3.asr_text: Friendlies inbound, sir! Looks like the 4th Armoured Division!
0371__L8_DAV_163__0A80F3EF.mp3.translation: 长官，自己人来了！看着是第四装甲师！

0372__L8_COO_80__1A2EC929.mp3.asr_text: I didn't think we were gonna make it out of there in one piece!
0372__L8_COO_80__1A2EC929.mp3.translation: 真没想到我们能毫发无损地从那儿逃出来！

0373__L8_MAD_37__0A7C9E28.mp3.asr_text: German convoy! They must be heading to the supply point!
0373__L8_MAD_37__0A7C9E28.mp3.translation: 德军车队！肯定是往补给点去的！

0374__L8_MAD_47__0C3176C7.mp3.asr_text: Looks like we lost sight of that convoy. We're close to the front lines now. The supply point can't be far off.
0374__L8_MAD_47__0C3176C7.mp3.translation: 好像跟丢那支车队了。离前线很近了，补给点应该就在附近。

0375__L8_TAY_44__3F81F668.mp3.asr_text: Uh-oh! Looks like we woke the neighbors!
0375__L8_TAY_44__3F81F668.mp3.translation: 哎哟，看来把邻居吵醒了！

0376__L8_MAD_58__0DF466E7.mp3.asr_text: Okay, tailor is clear. Take this shot, Sharp.
0376__L8_MAD_58__0DF466E7.mp3.translation: 泰勒已经撤开了。夏普，开枪！

0378__L8_SER_133__3EDCEBD9.mp3.asr_text: SHOP! COOPER! GIVE HIM SOME BACKUP!
0378__L8_SER_133__3EDCEBD9.mp3.note: SHOP疑似Sharpe，按喊人名夏普处理。

0379__L8_MAD_73__1117A2A0.mp3.asr_text: Private Sharp, get to the top floor and deal with that Jerry with the Panzer, Shrek!
0379__L8_MAD_73__1117A2A0.mp3.translation: 夏普，到顶楼去，干掉那个拿反坦克火箭筒的德国佬！
0379__L8_MAD_73__1117A2A0.mp3.note: Panzer, Shrek疑似Panzerschreck，按反坦克火箭筒修正。

0381__L8_MAD_185__DD414EE6.mp3.asr_text: Private Sharp, if you're that afraid of one little sniper, use a smoke grenade and get to cover.
0381__L8_MAD_185__DD414EE6.mp3.translation: 夏普，要真这么怕那个狙击手，就扔颗烟雾弹，躲到掩体里去。

0384__L8_TAY_118__0D57A76C.mp3.asr_text: Come on, mate! We're short on time!

0385__L8_MAD_153__D8069607.mp3.asr_text: Private Sharp, get in there and secure the windmill. I don't want any surprises.
0385__L8_MAD_153__D8069607.mp3.translation: 夏普，进去控制住风车。我可不想再撞上什么埋伏。

0386__L8_MAD_78__115E1825.mp3.asr_text: I think we've done enough damage for one day lads, let's leave something for the Yanks to do. Time to pull out.
0386__L8_MAD_78__115E1825.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，今天砸得够多了，给美国人留点活儿干。该撤了。

0388__L8_MAD_55__0DCA2064.mp3.asr_text: You wait here. I'll send Taylor down to set the explosives on one of those tanks. We'll begin the attack after they're detonated.
0388__L8_MAD_55__0DCA2064.mp3.translation: 你们在这儿等着。我派泰勒下去，给一辆坦克装炸药。炸药一响，我们就进攻。

0389__L8_MAD_3__A57CDC2B.mp3.translation: 等咱们收拾完他们，就不会了，泰勒。趁美国佬绊住德国鬼子，咱们趁机潜入，拔掉他们的前哨站，然后突进到城镇广场。都明白了吗？好了，开始行动！戴维斯和罗杰斯已经在前头探路了。
0389__L8_MAD_3__A57CDC2B.mp3.note: ASR因超长跳过。未使用AM旧稿补写，待补识别或听音。

0391__L8_TAY_81__462B1261.mp3.asr_text: I think we should be thanking old Sharpshooter there for that.
0391__L8_TAY_81__462B1261.mp3.translation: 我看该谢谢那边那位神枪手。

0392__L8_GER_24__4E470882.mp3.asr_text: Post Office 1, are you there? Hello? Hello?
0392__L8_GER_24__4E470882.mp3.note: Post Office 1疑似Outpost 1，结合另一条同角色无线电呼叫修正为一号哨所。

0393__L8_COO_14__0E753AD4.mp3.asr_text: Two more coming from the windmill, sir! Looks like we spooked them!
0393__L8_COO_14__0E753AD4.mp3.translation: 长官，又有两个从风车那儿来了！看来惊动他们了！

0395__L8_MAD_32__0A3628A3.mp3.asr_text: We all clear? Right, let's go!

0396__L8_TAY_38__3E057BCD.mp3.asr_text: So what do we do Sarge? Flag him down and ask for directions eh?
0396__L8_TAY_38__3E057BCD.mp3.translation: 那怎么办，中士？挥手拦下来，问个路？

0397__L8_MAD_40__0BCED240.mp3.asr_text: Crafty Jerry so and so, he's got his root well covered.
0397__L8_MAD_40__0BCED240.mp3.translation: 狡猾的德国佬，把沿路护得够严。

0398__L8_MAD_45__0C1547C5.mp3.asr_text: What are you waiting for, Sharp? A bloody invitation? Move!
0398__L8_MAD_45__0C1547C5.mp3.translation: 夏普，还等什么？要我发请帖吗？快走！

0399__L8_MAD_62__0F54B280.mp3.asr_text: Cooper, keep an eye out for enemy reinforcements. Private Sharp, keep us covered.
0399__L8_MAD_62__0F54B280.mp3.translation: 库珀，留意敌人的增援。夏普，掩护我们。

0400__L8_COO_67__1727BC72.mp3.asr_text: Enemy reinforcements! They're coming over the wall to the east!
0400__L8_COO_67__1727BC72.mp3.translation: 敌人增援！正从东边翻墙进来！

0402__L8_TAY_75__44AE97C6.mp3.asr_text: Tiger! I'm bloody big at this too! Over in the north corner!
0402__L8_TAY_75__44AE97C6.mp3.translation: 虎式！真他妈大！在北边的角落里！
0402__L8_TAY_75__44AE97C6.mp3.note: I'm bloody big at this疑似a bloody big one，按对虎式体型的感叹拟译，待听音。

0404__L8_TAY_188__194993C5.mp3.asr_text: Yeah, cos we're not afraid of him, not at all, no, no.
0404__L8_TAY_188__194993C5.mp3.translation: 是啊，我们可不怕他，一点都不怕，真的。

0405__L8_MAD_34__0A5257A5.mp3.asr_text: Hmm, with that bomb damage it looks like the main street is the only way for us to take. Let's go!
0405__L8_MAD_34__0A5257A5.mp3.translation: 炸成这样，看来只能走主街了。走！

0407__L8_MAD_105__CF9A89EE.mp3.asr_text: Ugh, there's two more up in that window to the northwest!
0407__L8_MAD_105__CF9A89EE.mp3.translation: 西北边那个窗口还有两个！

0408__L8_MAD_108__CFC4D071.mp3.asr_text: They're probably in place to lure us out into the open so a sniper can pick us off.
0408__L8_MAD_108__CFC4D071.mp3.translation: 八成是想把我们引到空地上，让狙击手一个个打掉。

0409__L8_TAY_109__0BB0E64E.mp3.asr_text: Looks like someone picked up a few tricks after Stalingrad.
0409__L8_TAY_109__0BB0E64E.mp3.translation: 看来有人在斯大林格勒学了几招。

0410__L8_MAD_110__D108ED08.mp3.asr_text: So it would seem. Sharp, we'll handle him. You find and kill that sniper.
0410__L8_MAD_110__D108ED08.mp3.translation: 看样子是。夏普，这几个交给我们，你去找到那个狙击手，干掉他。

0411__L8_TAY_84__465558E4.mp3.asr_text: Where do you suppose they're off to then?

0412__L11_Tay_14__5DCEB96B.mp3.asr_text: There's a patrol moving in at the far end!
0412__L11_Tay_14__5DCEB96B.mp3.translation: 远处有队巡逻兵过来了！

0414__L8_DAV_5__27614EB6.mp3.asr_text: Small patrol around the farmhouses in front of the windmill, sir. Three at the front and at least one round the back.
0414__L8_DAV_5__27614EB6.mp3.translation: 长官，风车前的农舍周围有支小巡逻队。前面三个，后面至少一个。

0416__L8_DAV_7__277D7DB8.mp3.asr_text: Can't be sure, sir. Rogers has gone ahead looking for a route in.
0416__L8_DAV_7__277D7DB8.mp3.translation: 不能确定，长官。罗杰斯去前面找路了。

0417__L8_MAD_8__A5C351B0.mp3.asr_text: Okay, we're moving up to Roger's position. When he gives the signal, we'll sneak past and jump the patrol.
0417__L8_MAD_8__A5C351B0.mp3.translation: 好，推进到罗杰斯的位置。他一发信号，我们就摸过去，打巡逻队个措手不及。

0419__L8_DAV_183__0DEAA52D.mp3.asr_text: Oh my... Sharp! Are you alright?

0421__L8_MAD_167__D9F3CCAA.mp3.asr_text: You see someone get on the line and tell them they took their damn time.
0421__L8_MAD_167__D9F3CCAA.mp3.translation: 谁去接通无线电，告诉他们来得可真够慢的！
0421__L8_MAD_167__D9F3CCAA.mp3.note: ASR句首粘连，参考AM仅修正Someone get on the line的句法。

0422__L8_MAD_82__12BE63BE.mp3.asr_text: Come on, the war's not gonna fight itself. Shift yourselves.
0422__L8_MAD_82__12BE63BE.mp3.translation: 快点，仗不会自己打完，都动起来。

0423__L8_TAY_27__3C428BAD.mp3.asr_text: Dull conversation anyway. That should put the wind up him for a while, eh?
0423__L8_TAY_27__3C428BAD.mp3.translation: 反正他们聊得也够无聊。这下能让那家伙慌上一阵了，是吧？

0425__L8_COO_15__0E835255.mp3.asr_text: Area's clear Sarge, looks like we got them all.
0425__L8_COO_15__0E835255.mp3.translation: 中士，这片清干净了，应该全解决了。

0426__L8_MAD_129__D33C9930.mp3.note: ASR仅有toff，无法可靠辨词；AM为Oh for…，暂拟为未说完的抱怨，需重点听音。

0427__L8_MAD_39__0A98CD2A.mp3.asr_text: We follow him. If we cut through this cafe, maybe we can find a way onto the street.
0427__L8_MAD_39__0A98CD2A.mp3.translation: 跟着他们。穿过这间咖啡馆，兴许能找到路进那条街。

0428__L8_MAD_41__0BDCE9C1.mp3.asr_text: Sharp, we're not gonna last long in this situation. Get rid of that sniper!
0428__L8_MAD_41__0BDCE9C1.mp3.translation: 夏普，这么下去咱们撑不了多久，干掉那个狙击手！

0429__L8_DAV_46__C3638CDD.mp3.note: Good workshop疑似Good work, Sharpe，按表扬夏普修正。

0430__L8_MAD_176__DB9A8DC8.mp3.asr_text: Remember, do not fire until I say otherwise.
0430__L8_MAD_176__DB9A8DC8.mp3.translation: 记住，没有我的命令不许开枪。

0431__L8_TAY_63__42DD9025.mp3.asr_text: Sir, we've secured the crate of Panzerschrax!
0431__L8_TAY_63__42DD9025.mp3.translation: 长官，我们弄到一箱反坦克火箭筒！
0431__L8_TAY_63__42DD9025.mp3.note: Panzerschrax疑似Panzerschrecks，按反坦克火箭筒处理。

0432__L8_TAY_131__105EB423.mp3.asr_text: Sir, we got company entering the building from the east wall!
0432__L8_TAY_131__105EB423.mp3.translation: 长官，有敌人从东墙那边进楼了！

0433__L8_MAD_71__10FB739E.mp3.asr_text: Where the hell did that Panzerschreck come from?
0433__L8_MAD_71__10FB739E.mp3.translation: 那支该死的反坦克火箭筒是从哪儿来的？

0434__L8_MAD_76__1141E923.mp3.asr_text: SHOP! TAKE THAT TANK OUT NOW! TAYLOR, COVER HIM!
0434__L8_MAD_76__1141E923.mp3.translation: 夏普！马上干掉那辆坦克！泰勒，掩护他！
0434__L8_MAD_76__1141E923.mp3.note: SHOP疑似Sharpe，按喊人名夏普处理。
